Your perfect base for the Riviera Nayarit. 🌴

Sayulita sits at the heart of one of the most beautiful coastlines in Mexico. From SkyHouse, every adventure is within reach — surf breaks, jungle hikes, whale watching, the Marieta Islands, Puerto Vallarta, Punta de Mita, small fishing villages, world-class restaurants.

You could never run out of things to do here. But honestly? The hardest part is leaving the pool.

🌊 5 min to the beach
🧭 Day trips in every direction
